'''''Sobralia macrantha''''', commonly known as the '''large-flowered sobralia''', is a species of [[orchid]] found from north-central and southern [[Mexico]] to [[Central America]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Benzing |first=D. H. |last2=Ott |first2=D. W. |last3=Friedman |first3=W. E. |date=April 1982 |title=ROOTS OF SOBRALIA MACRANTHA (ORCHIDACEAE): STRUCTURE AND FUNCTION OF THE VELAMEN‐EXODERMIS COMPLEX |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/j.1537-2197.1982.tb13297.x |journal=American Journal of Botany |language=en |volume=69 |issue=4 |pages=608–614 |doi=10.1002/j.1537-2197.1982.tb13297.x |issn=0002-9122|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
